## Buildkite (Remote)

Buildkite's hosted MCP server exposes pipelines, builds, job logs, artifacts, and test results. Use it to investigate CI failures and manage builds without running a local server.

### Setup

You need a Buildkite account with access to the organization and resources you want to use. Run `thv run buildkite-remote --remote-auth` and complete the browser authorization, including your organization's SSO if required. The server supports dynamic client registration, so no pre-created OAuth application or custom headers are needed. If your organization restricts API access by IP address, an administrator must allow Buildkite's remote MCP egress IPs as described in the [connection guide](https://buildkite.com/docs/apis/mcp-server/remote/configuring-ai-tools).

The default endpoint permits reads and writes within your granted permissions. Buildkite also provides `https://mcp.buildkite.com/mcp/readonly` and toolset-specific paths. For headless API-token access, use `https://mcp.buildkite.com/direct` with `--remote-auth-bearer-token-file <TOKEN_FILE>`; API tokens belong on that endpoint, while this entry uses OAuth. The hosted service has its own rate limits and updates automatically.
